Cotham infection were identified during January 11–December 10, 2024. Eighteen reported cases were among persons with household exposure to bearded dragons; *S.* Cotham isolates from two bearded dragons kept in two patient households were closely genetically related to each other, to 2012–2014 isolates, and to clinical isolates from the 26 confirmed cases.
